Anthropic’s IPO could make about 4,250 of its 5,300 employees millionaires, per an analysis by financial platform Hill, including roughly 50 worth more than $100 million each.

The estimate assumes a $1.5 trillion valuation, above the roughly $1 trillion Anthropic is now targeting.
